operation.name: GetTypeOfGrievances
operation.query: SELECT [TypeOfGrievanceID] ,[Name] ,[Active] FROM [LK_TypeOfGrievance] WHERE ACTIVE = 1 ORDER BY Name ASC

operation.name: GetTypeOfGrievance
operation.query: SELECT [TypeOfGrievanceID] ,[Name] ,[Active] FROM [LK_TypeOfGrievance] WHERE ACTIVE = 1 AND TypeOfGrievanceID = @TypeOfGrievanceID ORDER BY Name ASC
